Game Overview

At its heart, Chicken Crossed is a casual game about guide a fearless chicken through bustling roads, treacherous rivers, and tricky obstacles in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Tap to jump and navigate, collect coins to unlock helpful animal allies, and face escalating challenges with quick reflexes and strategic moves for endless fun.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Chicken Crossed is easy to pick up. Guide a fearless chicken through bustling roads, treacherous rivers, and tricky obstacles in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Tap to jump and navigate, collect coins to unlock helpful animal allies, and face escalating challenges with quick reflexes and strategic moves for endless fun.
